build.local_artifact_policy: Explicit local-package clean; verify fresh=false for every local compiler artifact.

main_transplant.contract: Main production tokens equal validated W5 snapshot; inherited line endings and final test-only blank lines may differ.

timing_contract: Rotated/reversed independent-process variant order; first calls excluded from medians, retained in raw rows. All accepted baseline output hashes enforced on every result. Unique removes byte-identical payload duplicates before API, so its speedup cannot be due to batch duplicate sharing. No input/filesystem cold-cache claim. Process peak working set includes loading, verification and retained results; not heap payload. Optional prewarm runs are archived separately and were declared before the cohort. Instrumented timing is diagnostic only and must not be used as performance evidence.
limitations: All speed binaries use full Luau+Lua51 package selection, including syn1 extra-traits; W3 API-only binary is excluded.
No owned build/test/corpus scan/source edits ran during timing. Agents confirmed idle; root only polled benchmark stdout and waited.
One-thread samples still drift despite the declared prewarm. Pooled medians differ substantially from means/paired ratios; no samples are discarded.
Whole-corpus arithmetic means aggregate equal-size corpus runs, not an unweighted mean of per-script speedup percentages.
Six measured corpus samples per variant mean nearest-rank p95 is the sample maximum; this is not a precise population-tail estimate.
No cold-filesystem, universal hardware, 2x or 3x–5x result is established.
Allocation-count/phase-profile times overlap other work and are not speed evidence.
W4-symbol WPR attempt failed before benchmark launch; no ETW CPU attribution exists. Current W5 process-only sampled endpoints are recorded separately and are not CPU percentages.
W5 was promoted after validation. Subsequent W6 results are reported separately, without multiplying ratios from different cohorts.

validation.contract: Actual local workerd; duplicate success/panic/base64 errors and metadata order, option flags, empty batch, repeated requests; three pinned corpus representatives twice.

sampled_endpoints.contract: Counts of sampled stack endpoints preceded by positive thread CPU progress, not CPU percentages. Inclusive groups overlap. Flat/leaf is the observed instruction's symbol, not measured exclusive CPU time. No speedup claim.

output_gate.allocation_contract: Separate instrumented build: successful Rust global allocator calls and requested payload bytes, including full new sizes for reallocations. Live/peak requested payloads include preloaded inputs and retained API results. Allocator arenas, native allocations and OS working set are not inferred from these counts. Instrumented timings are not performance samples.
output_gate.contract: Input loading/base64 decode, Rayon pool creation, hashing and caller result disposal are outside timing. Round zero is the first call, followed by repeated calls in the same process. All source bytes match the locked CLI hashes. This is not cold filesystem-cache timing.

quality.contract: Endpoint stack observations selected by positive preceding thread CPU delta. Fractions are not CPU percentages. Setup, hashing, disposal and idle endpoints remain possible. Inclusive rows overlap; never sum them.

limitations: Only one process, one workload, one affinity and a first/repeated call pair. Endpoint/scheduler bias remains; randomized delay does not make samples independent.
GetThreadTimes is coarse. CPU progress can precede a waiting endpoint; accounting coverage is not proof of correct stack attribution.
Toolhelp once-per-second refresh costs about90ms and may miss the first second of a new worker. Process setup/hash/disposal are separated by thread/stack where possible, not exact phase markers.
Soft10ms unwind caps truncate some caller chains, undercounting outer inclusive functions. Leaf observations remain retained. No inline-frame expansion is performed.
Optimized PDB names may alias under folding; a panic_unwind name in a parent frame does not establish a panic. Unknown system module addresses remain visible.
The optimized symbol build has verified source/features/package selection/native allocator identity, but it is not a substitute for ordinary release timing cohorts.
